_how_it_works: Words the French Piper voices would otherwise read the English way (or wrongly). Left: the word as written on the page. Right: how it should sound, in the voice's phonetic symbols. The audio script swaps each word for its sound before speaking; the text on the page is never changed. Add a line for any new word.
_phrases_how_it_works: Phrases to be said slightly differently in the recording only. Kept empty on purpose: pauses (commas) inserted here made the recordings sound machine-made. Final consonants before a vowel are now handled by the audio check itself (see Activity kit › Audio check).
